description: Reconciles the LPBS test-mode catalog against Stripe and executes payment outcome journeys with durable provider evidence.

notApplicableKinds.reason: This provider requires scenario monetization declarations and local metering posture; the control plane has no product monetization contract.

determinism.reason: The phase reads the authority-backed Stripe test catalog and retains only observed test-mode outcomes; unrun behaviors stay unknown.

levels.name: Inventory unavailable
exit_criteria: Source and declaration surfaces are readable.

levels.name: Trust boundary
levels.description: The static trust-boundary checks run and findings are visible.
exit_criteria: No shared service secret or symmetric verifier is present.

levels.name: Declared
levels.description: The monetization surface is declared and enforcement paths are inspectable.
exit_criteria: Manifest and enforcement paths are present.

levels.name: Hardened
levels.description: Class A and Class B meters have the required server or durable-local posture.
exit_criteria: Each Class B meter declares exactly one supported accounting mode.

levels.name: Complete
levels.description: The scenario is ready for monetization assurance.

levels.name: Not run
levels.description: Stripe test outcomes have no durable receipt.
levels.next_unlock: Run the local Stripe outcome phase.

levels.name: Catalog checked
levels.description: Test catalog IDs are reconciled against Stripe.
exit_criteria: All configured Stripe test price IDs, amounts, currencies, intervals, and active status reconcile with LPBS.
levels.next_unlock: Deliver a signed test webhook to LPBS.

levels.name: Webhook delivered
levels.description: A test-mode Stripe webhook is processed, its minimized event receipt is persisted in LPBS Postgres, and its event/object IDs and status are retained in Test Genie evidence.
exit_criteria: LPBS stores event ID, type, object ID, test mode and processed status without retaining the provider payload.
Test Genie retains the matched event ID, type, object ID and status from the Postgres receipt.
levels.capability_summary: A scenario has a declared, server-authoritative monetization boundary with clean trust-boundary checks.
levels.next_unlock: Replay subscription and payment lifecycle outcomes.

levels.name: Lifecycle replayed
levels.description: Checkout and billing outcomes have durable receipts.
entry_criteria: Declaration and enforcement paths are valid.
exit_criteria: Every required checkout, subscription, top-up, and donation outcome has a durable Postgres and money-ledger receipt.
levels.next_unlock: Repeat on CL2 staging with ledger evidence.

levels.name: Staging proven
levels.description: Every required outcome passed on staging with Postgres and money-ledger evidence.
entry_criteria: All static and live checks pass.
exit_criteria: Every required outcome and corresponding money-ledger evidence passes on CL2 staging in Stripe test mode.
levels.capability_summary: The declared monetization boundary is live-reconciled and behaviorally evidenced across desktop and service surfaces.

stripe.behavior_not_replayed.reason: Run and retain the required test-mode Stripe webhook and lifecycle evidence.

stripe.catalog_mismatch.reason: Reconcile each test catalog entry with the Stripe provider before checkout.
